title: Healing Touch and Relaxation Therapies in Cervical Cancer Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effects of healing touch and relaxation therapy on cervical cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy and radiation treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stage Ib1-IVa cervical cancer
* Treatment with concurrent chemotherapy and radiation at the University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics

Exclusion Criteria:

* Immunosuppressive disorders
* Use of immunosuppressive medications
* Transplant recipient
* Metastatic or recurrent cervical cancer
* History of any other type of cancer
